purpose: Convert between units of length, weight, and temperature with a clean UI
rootCause: data-store.ts calls convert() which lives in core-engine.ts — but data_store's wiring deps are only input_handler, so it CANNOT import it. The model wrote a handleConversion() that duplicates input-handler's job instead of reusing the imported handleInput. The scope-leak lint DID flag convert but its guidance ('declare it locally or pass as a parameter') didn't fit a cross-module function, so the model re-emitted the same call across all 3 repair rounds. ALSO: a lint false positive (value flagged as undeclared when it IS the param of handleConversion(value): the param regex required the parens to end the prelude, so return-typed exported functions never collected their params) diluted the repair signal.
pipelineFix: (1) findScopeLeaks now takes sibling-export context: a leaked name exported by a DEPENDENCY says 'import it'; exported only by a NON-dependency sibling says 'you CANNOT import it — remove this code and use a function from your actual dependencies'. (2) Param regex accepts an optional return type after ')' so f(x: string): T { collects x. (3) collectAllDecls methodRe no longer treats line-start bare calls foo(); as method declarations (added (?!\s*[;=]) guard).
notes: Teacher re-run (seq 15) launched with the fixed guidance to measure pass-rate improvement.
